# ownyourjev v2 results (generated by benchmarks/v2/report.py)

Jev = jev-1.13.0, re-scored from the paper's per-example responses on exactly our evaluation examples. Ours = ~150M encoder trained on LLM labels + 220 gold examples from the training split, all choices made on dev, CPU int8/fp32 ONNX. Verdict: win if our 95% bootstrap CI is entirely above Jev, tie if it contains Jev, loss if entirely below. Latency = worst p50/p95 over repeated runs on a quiet machine (4 threads, batch 1, all of a task's questions per request); gate p95 < 70 ms.
